findings.evidence: grep -nE "posSemidef_|normSq_le_of|eq_zero_of_apply|norm_le_one_of_apply|rankOne|schur_" on Kolmogorov.lean hits only its own `posSemidef_positiveDefiniteKernelOperator` (lines 34, 79, 128, 136, 147, 174) and Mathlib's `RKHS.posSemidef_tfae` (line 83); none of the ten declarations of TauCeti/Analysis/Matrix/PosSemidef.lean (lines 91-230) appear. Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Reproducing.lean:9 imports Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Positive, which uses Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec at line 208, so Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef is already in scope.
findings.fix: Drop the import; `Matrix.PosSemidef` is already available transitively through the existing `public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Reproducing`. If a direct import is preferred, use `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef`, matching what this PR already did in `Bochner/Gaussian/Regularization.lean:9`.
findings.issue: `public import TauCeti.Analysis.Matrix.PosSemidef` is unused: the file uses only Mathlib's `Matrix.PosSemidef` (`hK.isHermitian`, `hK.2`, and the predicate in statements), not any `TauCeti.posSemidef_*` / `normSq_le_of_posSemidef` / rank-one / Schur declaration. Being public it propagates the whole TauCeti matrix API downstream.

summary: Placement of the new TauCeti/Analysis/Matrix/PosSemidef.lean is correct and both prior findings are fixed, but Kernel/Kolmogorov.lean was rerouted to publicly import that module while using no declaration from it.
